articles.title: Tick-Borne Encephalitis Vaccine Effectiveness and Impact in Slovenia, 2019-2024.

en.research_question: What is the estimated protective efficacy and population-level impact of tick-borne encephalitis immunization among Slovenian residents?
en.study_design: An observational evaluation utilizing a screening methodology to compare vaccination proportions between confirmed infection cases and a broader survey cohort across a five-year interval.
en.population_setting: Individuals residing in Slovenia, specifically analyzing patients with documented tick-borne encephalitis diagnoses and a separate sample of surveyed adults regarding their immunization status.
en.main_findings: The analysis determined a ninety-three point four percent protection rate for recipients completing three or more scheduled doses. This coverage level resulted in an estimated four hundred twenty-six avoided infections during the study period, while hypothetical universal adoption projected nearly one thousand additional prevented cases.
en.public_health_relevance: The data demonstrate significant disease reduction potential through routine immunization, though they simultaneously reveal substantial gaps in current community participation that warrant expanded promotional strategies.
en.limitations: The evaluation is constrained by incomplete immunization documentation for nearly half of the reported infections and utilizes survey-derived denominators rather than exhaustive demographic tracking.
en.gids_interpretation: This record supplies historical performance metrics and regional coverage estimates that can inform trend analysis and program planning, serving as a static reference point for epidemiological context.

zh.research_question: 瑞典户外职业人群对蜱传脑炎的疫苗接种覆盖率及其相关知识、态度与行为现状如何？
zh.study_design: 该研究采用全国性横断面调查设计，于二零二四年收集数据以评估目标人群的免疫实践状况。
zh.population_setting: 研究对象为瑞典从事农业、林业、狩猎、科研及自然导览等户外作业成年人员。
zh.main_findings: 受访者对疫苗的认知与态度整体处于中等偏上水平，但实际接种率未能同步提升且存在显著差异。女性群体及南部和中部地区居民的参与比例较高，约七成报告已完成至少三剂接种，但部分细分人群中仍存在未接种现象。
zh.public_health_relevance: 尽管高危职业群体具备一定疾病防范意识，但免疫屏障尚未完全建立，提示需通过定向干预与政策优化来缩小接种缺口。
zh.limitations: 作为基于单一时间点的横断面自我报告调查，该设计难以确立变量间的时序关系，且可能受到回忆偏差的影响。
zh.gids_interpretation: 本文提供了瑞典特定职业暴露背景下的免疫模式基线信息，可作为区域健康监测框架的背景参考，不涉及实时疫情信号关联。

en.research_question: The investigation aimed to quantify tick-borne encephalitis immunization rates among Swedish individuals employed in outdoor occupations, addressing a documented gap in existing epidemiological data.
en.study_design: Researchers utilized a nationwide cross-sectional survey methodology to collect self-reported knowledge, attitudes, and practice data during 2024.
en.population_setting: The analytical sample comprised 1006 consenting adults working in outdoor sectors such as agriculture, forestry, hunting, scientific research, and wildlife guiding across Sweden.
en.main_findings: Participants exhibited moderate awareness and positive views regarding immunization, yet actual uptake rates fell short of these metrics and differed markedly across demographics. Female respondents achieved higher assessment scores and vaccination rates than males, while geographic analysis revealed superior coverage in southern and central counties relative to northern areas. Roughly seventy percent indicated completion of a three-dose regimen, although distinct demographic clusters remained largely unprotected.
en.public_health_relevance: Rising regional disease incidence contrasts with the exclusion of the prophylactic agent from official immunization schedules, highlighting the need for occupational-specific interventions and financial support mechanisms to mitigate transmission risk.
en.limitations: The cross-sectional framework restricts temporal analysis of behavioral shifts, and reliance on self-reported immunization records introduces potential recall inaccuracies.
en.gids_interpretation: This publication establishes a descriptive baseline for occupational immunization patterns, offering contextual reference points for literature mapping and regional health strategy discussions without implying real-time outbreak tracking.

articles.title: A Case-Control Study on the Effectiveness of Tick-Borne Encephalitis Vaccination Against Hospitalizations in an Endemic Area in Northeastern Italy.

en.research_question: What is the protective impact of the tick-borne encephalitis immunization regimen in preventing severe disease requiring medical admission among residents of a recognized endemic zone in northeastern Italy?
en.study_design: The investigation employed a case-control methodology utilizing linked regional health records spanning seven years. Participants were stratified based on hospitalization status following laboratory confirmation of infection.
en.population_setting: The analysis focused on inhabitants of the Udine province within the Friuli Venezia Giulia region, which is classified as an endemic zone for the pathogen.
en.main_findings: Individuals receiving three or more vaccine doses demonstrated a substantially reduced likelihood of hospital admission compared to those without immunization. Provincial coverage reached approximately ten percent, with notably higher rates recorded in elevated geographic districts.
en.public_health_relevance: The documentation underscores the value of immunization strategies in reducing severe disease outcomes within affected communities. Regional variations in coverage indicate opportunities for targeted outreach initiatives to improve community protection.
en.limitations: The evaluation was constrained by a limited number of confirmed hospitalization events.
en.gids_interpretation: This publication offers background information on regional immunization practices and documented protection levels against severe neurological infections. It serves as a reference point for understanding historical prevention efforts rather than indicating current outbreak dynamics.

articles.title: A rare case of breakthrough tick-borne encephalitis in early adolescence after vaccination with four doses of TBE vaccine.

zh.research_question: 本文探讨了一名完成四剂疫苗接种的青少年在突破感染蜱传脑炎后的临床表现、诊断标志物特征及长期预后。
zh.study_design: 该研究为单病例报告，详细记录了一名患者的临床病程、实验室检测数据及影像学随访结果。
zh.population_setting: 研究对象为一名既往健康的早期青少年，已完成四剂蜱传脑炎疫苗接种。
zh.main_findings: 尽管完成全程接种，患者仍发生重症突破感染并住院三个月。血清学显示典型IgM反应延迟，而脑脊液中针对非结构蛋白1的早期IgG应答具有较高诊断价值。初始治疗曾按自身免疫性脑炎进行免疫调节干预，多年随访的脑部影像学检查证实存在持续性病变，但导致严重预后的具体机制尚不明确。
zh.public_health_relevance: 该案例提示在已接种疫苗人群中仍需警惕突破感染的可能，并强调了特定生物标志物在鉴别诊断中的潜在作用，对完善相关疾病的临床识别策略具有参考价值。
zh.limitations: 作为单一病例报告，样本量极小且缺乏对照，难以推断普遍规律或明确致病机制。此外，免疫调节治疗的潜在影响及其他黄病毒交叉反应可能干扰临床判断。
zh.gids_interpretation: 该文献属于个案报道范畴，主要提供特定人群下罕见突破感染的临床细节与实验室特征，有助于丰富现有疾病认知框架，但不涉及实时监测数据的关联分析。

en.research_question: How can clinicians characterize the clinical trajectory and laboratory markers associated with a rare post-vaccination neurological complication?
en.study_design: This investigation utilizes a descriptive case report format to document a single patient encounter.
en.population_setting: The subject is a previously healthy adolescent who had received four prior vaccinations against the targeted pathogen.
en.main_findings: The individual developed severe encephalitis requiring extended hospitalization despite complete immunization history. Laboratory analysis indicated a postponed IgM reaction but demonstrated early IgG production targeting the NS1 protein within cerebrospinal fluid. Longitudinal imaging confirmed enduring neurological alterations, while the precise drivers of the severe progression were not determined.
en.public_health_relevance: The documentation emphasizes the continued possibility of serious neurological illness in fully immunized populations. It also suggests that medical professionals should maintain awareness of infectious triggers when evaluating acute inflammatory symptoms.
en.limitations: The singular focus on one patient prevents generalization to wider demographic groups or definitive mechanistic conclusions. Authors explicitly acknowledge that the factors contributing to the severe clinical course remain unknown.
en.gids_interpretation: This record offers background context on atypical immunological profiles and diagnostic methodologies following prophylactic administration. It functions as a reference resource for understanding complex clinical presentations without implying active monitoring activity.

articles.title: Tick-borne encephalitis in the Åland Islands, Finland: incidence and disease course since the implementation of a general TBE vaccination programme.

related_surveillance.method: high-confidence article geography intersected with GIDS series coverage

en.research_question: What are the epidemiological trends, clinical characteristics, and long-term prognoses of tick-borne encephalitis in an endemic Finnish archipelago after routine immunization began?
en.study_design: A retrospective observational analysis examining medical records and laboratory results for confirmed cases spanning nearly two decades.
en.population_setting: Individuals diagnosed with the viral infection in the Åland Islands, Finland, between 2006 and 2023 using standardized European diagnostic standards.
en.main_findings: The analysis identified 145 cases with a median annual incidence of twenty-nine per one hundred thousand residents. Hospitalization was common, disease severity increased with patient age, and two deaths occurred. Most survivors regained clinical function within two years, though partial vaccination histories showed higher rates of breakthrough illness.
en.public_health_relevance: Stable regional case counts contrast with rising trends elsewhere, suggesting potential benefits from sustained immunization efforts. Monitoring disease patterns across different vaccination statuses may help guide future preventive planning.
en.limitations: The retrospective chart review design inherently limits causal inference and introduces potential documentation biases. The absence of a concurrent comparison group restricts the ability to isolate intervention effects from other epidemiological factors.
en.gids_interpretation: This article documents longitudinal clinical and epidemiological observations for a specific arbovirus within a defined geographic area. The reported incidence figures and recovery rates offer contextual reference points for understanding regional disease dynamics.

articles.title: Fatal European subtype tick-borne encephalitis in a fully vaccinated immunocompetent child: a case report with viral sequencing.

en.research_question: The report examines the clinical progression and diagnostic challenges encountered during a fatal tick-borne encephalitis infection in a fully immunized child.
en.study_design: The investigation employs a single-patient case report methodology to document clinical observations and laboratory analyses.
en.population_setting: The subject was a nine-year-old previously healthy individual assessed within an emergency department framework located in a region with known pathogen circulation.
en.main_findings: The patient experienced rapid neurological deterioration without characteristic febrile phases, culminating in fatal intracranial complications. Genomic sequencing identified the vaccine-matched European viral strain. Definitive diagnosis relied on detecting immunoglobulin G against the NS1 protein alongside post-mortem tissue amplification.
en.public_health_relevance: The documentation underscores the continued importance of pediatric immunization protocols and maintaining clinical suspicion in geographically susceptible zones. It further suggests that monitoring NS1-specific antibodies could enhance detection accuracy within vaccinated cohorts.
en.limitations: The singular observational structure prevents statistical generalization and limits the identification of broader demographic risk factors.
en.gids_interpretation: This publication contributes a documented instance of severe pediatric disease that occurred despite standard immunization, offering additional clinical context for symptom variability and serological markers. The record serves as a reference point for understanding atypical presentations and diagnostic pathways within the existing medical literature.

zh.research_question: 本研究旨在评估脑脊液中蜱传脑炎病毒核酸的检测能力，并观察该指标与患者临床表现及疾病严重程度的对应关系。
zh.study_design: 研究基于瑞典两地医疗机构的回顾性数据，对2015至2020年间的患者脑脊液样本进行逆转录聚合酶链反应分析，并调取电子病历记录进行对照。
